title: Write stub UUIDs into binary DMX element references
problem: Binary DMX export writes the -2 stub marker without the required UUID string, corrupting the remaining stream and producing empty Source Filmmaker imports.
reproduce: Export an element containing StubElement.stub(uuid) to BytesIO and parse it; the baseline parser raises ValueError because it reaches EOF while reading the absent UUID.
acceptance: The exported file parses successfully and retains the format metadata, stub type and exact UUID.
repair: Write the ASCII UUID plus a null terminator immediately after every -2 binary stub marker and add an in-memory round-trip regression.

selection.reason: A three-day-old user report has an exact EOF reproduction, application impact, no competing PR, and a one-line format repair backed by a native round trip.

verification.limitations: BCL runs the real Python DMX writer and parser. The focused test passes; 122 tests in test_dmx.py passed separately, while one unrelated test requires the optional compiled tokenizer extension. Source Filmmaker was not available locally.
verification.ownerCheck: Round-trip an animation DMX containing external element stubs through srctools, import it in Source Filmmaker, and confirm the referenced channels are retained rather than importing as an empty file.
